q1.question: How do I reset my password?
q1.answer: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page, enter your email and follow the instructions sent to your inbox.

q2.question: How do I track my order?
q2.answer: Log in to your account, go to 'My orders' and click on the order to see its real-time status.

q3.question: How do I become a seller?
q3.answer: Create an account, then select 'Become a seller' in your profile. Fill in the required information and your shop will be active within 24h.
